hero.tagline: Umuryango wa Anglikani wakira bose i Kacyiru
hero.intro: Muze dusengere hamwe ku cyumweru kuri {name}. Amateraniro y'Icyongereza saa {en}, ay'Ikinyarwanda saa {rw}.
times.title: Amasaha y'amateraniro
welcome.title: Murakaza neza
welcome.body: {name} ni paruwasi ya Kiliziya Anglikani y'u Rwanda, ikorera imiryango i Kacyiru no muri {diocese}. Waba usengera mu Cyongereza cyangwa mu Kinyarwanda, ngwino uko uri uhure n'umuryango usenga, uririmba kandi ukorera hamwe.
min.title: Shaka itsinda ryawe
give.title: Dushyigikire umurimo wa paruwasi
give.text: Icyacumi n'amaturo yanyu bifasha amateraniro, ubufasha ku bakeneye n'umurimo w'urubyiruko i Kacyiru.
loc.title: Mudusure
sermon.text: Waburiye ku cyumweru? Reba inyigisho iheruka.
events.title: Ibikorwa biri imbere
p.sermons.intro: Reba cyangwa wumve inyigisho ziheruka mu materaniro yacu.
p.events.intro: Amateraniro n'ibikorwa bizaba kuri EAR Kacyiru.
p.ministries.intro: Buri wese afite aho ahurira muri paruwasi yacu.
p.choirs.intro: Umuziki ni umutima w'amasengesho kuri EAR Kacyiru.
p.giving.intro: Murakoze gushyigikira amateraniro, ubufasha n'umurimo w'urubyiruko muri paruwasi yacu.
form.name: Amazina yawe
form.sent: Murakoze. Ubutumwa bwawe bwoherejwe, tuzagusubiza vuba.
prayer.name: Amazina (si ngombwa)
prayer.share: Tanga iki cyifuzo ku itsinda ry'amasengesho
